# Throwable carrier with fixed nominal contexts

An owned void provider retains one method-owned Throwable formal in an invariant
unary input and its original throws slot. Two Object contexts keep their original
identities, nulls, aliases and order. Four frozen caller routes compare 96 cases
twice, including lazy supplier execution, checked/runtime/Error identities, null
and invalid provider values, input casts, staged writes and alias-sensitive
mutation. Source and SDK profiles compile every recovered unit and audit all
original metadata and roles. Six wrong programs and six Code-preserving Signature
controls independently test the observer and binding boundary. Only owned code
and in-memory values execute.
